rules.title: Annual General Adjustment (AGA) capped at 5%
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quote: The maximum AGA is 5%. This means that, if the formula in the Rent Ordinance results in an AGA that is greater than 5%, the AGA approved by the Board for that year can be no more than 5%.
rules.summary: Annual rent increases for fully-covered units are capped at a maximum of 5%, even if the Consumer Price Index formula would result in a higher amount.
rules.effective_date_evidence: For tenancies started on or after December 20, 2024
rules.exemption_note: Single-family homes and condominiums are generally not fully covered unless tenancy began prior to 1996 or rooms are rented individually. Units with certificates of occupancy issued after 1980 are partially covered. Government-subsidized units may be fully or partially covered depending on subsidy type.
rules.penalty: Rent Board has power to adopt fines for noncompliance with registration requirements including failure to report tenancy information in a timely manner.

rules.title: Nonpayment eviction threshold increased to one month Fair Market Rent
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quote: For a landlord to evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent, the tenant must owe an amount of rental debt equal to or greater than one month of the Fair Market Rent (FMR) value for a unit of equivalent size in the metro area Oakland-Fremont, CA HUD Metro FMR as determined by the US Department of Housing and Urban Development for the fiscal year in which the rent is demanded.
rules.summary: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for nonpayment of rent unless the tenant owes at least one month of the HUD Fair Market Rent for a comparable unit size in the Oakland-Fremont metro area.
rules.key_value: 1 month Fair Market Rent (Oakland-Fremont HUD FMR)
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance
rules.exemption_note: Applies to fully or partially covered units only; exempt units include most new construction after 1980, single-family homes with tenancies started after 1995 (unless five or more rooms rented individually), and units where landlord shares kitchen/bath and lived there before tenant moved in.

rules.title: Eviction for failure to sign new lease eliminated
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quote: A landlord cannot evict a tenant for failing to sign a substantially similar lease upon expiration of a fixed-term lease.
rules.summary: Landlords may not evict tenants for refusing to sign a new fixed-term lease when the prior lease expires.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance
rules.exemption_note: Applies to fully or partially covered units only.

rules.title: Lease violation eviction requirements: material terms must cause actual harm and tenant behavior must be unreasonable
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quote: Material lease terms only include mutually agreed upon lease terms. The alleged violation must cause substantial, actual damage to the landlord. The landlord must demonstrate that the tenant's behavior was unreasonable.
rules.summary: To evict for a lease violation, the landlord must show the violation was of a mutually agreed term, caused substantial actual damage to the landlord, and the tenant's behavior was unreasonable.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
rules.coverage_text: tenants in units that are fully or partially covered by the Rent Ordinance
rules.exemption_note: Applies to fully or partially covered units only.

rules.title: Eviction notice content and filing requirements
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quote: Any notice terminating a tenancy must contain a statement that advice about the notice is available from the Rent Board, the current phone number for the Rent Board's Housing counseling services, and the current address of the Rent Board's website. The landlord must file with the Rent Board a copy of any notice to terminate a tenancy, notice to quit, and summons and complaint no later than three business days after the tenant was served with the document.
rules.summary: Eviction notices must include information about Rent Board counseling services and the Rent Board website, and landlords must file copies of termination notices and eviction lawsuits with the Rent Board within three business days of serving the tenant.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election

rules.exemption_note: Applies to fully or partially covered units only.

rules.title: Annual adjustment of owner move-in eviction relocation assistance
rules.citation: Berkeley Rent Ordinance as amended by Measure BB (November 2024)
rules.quote: The Rent Board must make inflationary adjustments to owner move-in eviction relocation assistance amounts each year.
rules.summary: The Rent Board is required to annually adjust the amounts of relocation assistance payments for owner move-in evictions to account for inflation.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Measure BB, a ballot measure passed by Berkeley voters in the November 2024 election
